spec2def(ufatx.dll ufatx.spec)

# ufatx.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ufatx-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(ufatx_shims OBJECT ufatx.c)
target_link_libraries(ufatx_shims PRIVATE vfatxlib libntdll)
add_cargo_module(ufatx ufatx-cargo ufatx.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ufatx_shims psdk)
